meta.description: Walking the edge of danger, concealing oneself in the shadows.

units.rawText: At the safehouse on the outskirts of the city.

units.rawText: Before heading out, we give Chris some training on how to use the radio set and radar system. She's surprisingly hardworking despite her young age and quickly commits our words to memory. Just before we go, I give her a reminder.

units.rawText: Chris, if Centaureissi and I fail to arrive at the designated point, it means the mission has failed. The enemy will be on alert, and that means you'll need to tell the defenders and the reinforcement troops to change their plan.
units.displayText: Chris, if Centaureissi and I fail to arrive at the designated point, it means the mission has failed. The enemy will be on alert, and that means you'll need to tell the defenders and the reinforcement troops to change their plan.

units.rawText: If we're not around and you encounter danger, don't panic. Remember what I taught you: Use the optical camouflage module to find a chance and slip away.

units.rawText: Yes, we will. Stay safe, Chris.

units.rawText: Centaureissi, let's split up. I'll look for their camera control center and disable it so the enemy won't discover the reinforcements as they move along the mountain trail.
units.displayText: Centaureissi, let's split up. I'll look for their camera control center and disable it so the enemy won't discover the reinforcements as they move along the mountain trail.

spans.text: Centaureissi, let's split up. I'll look for their camera control center and disable it so the enemy won't discover the reinforcements as they move along the mountain trail.

units.rawText: Once I disable the cameras and comms, I'll turn the lights at their comms center on and off twice, which will be the signal for you to begin.
units.displayText: Once I disable the cameras and comms, I'll turn the lights at their comms center on and off twice, which will be the signal for you to begin.

spans.text: Once I disable the cameras and comms, I'll turn the lights at their comms center on and off twice, which will be the signal for you to begin.

units.rawText: Your target will be their armory; you must make a "clean sweep" of it. We'll rendezvous at this location the next time the guards have a shift change.

units.rawText: Think of it as a good luck charm.
units.displayText: Think of it as a good luck charm.

spans.text: Think of it as a good luck charm.

units.rawText: I will. Thank you, Centaureissi.
units.displayText: I will. Thank you, Centaureissi.

spans.text: I will. Thank you, Centaureissi.

units.rawText: Please keep yourself safe, Commander.
units.displayText: Please keep yourself safe, Commander.

spans.text: Please keep yourself safe, Commander.

units.displayText: Yes, Commander!

units.displayText: What shitty luck, I lost a bet with the duty sentry yesterday and had to buy him a beer.

units.displayText: What did you bet on?

units.rawText: I bet on when the new ammo would arrive. We used up almost all our stock on the previous round of bombardment. If it doesn't arrive soon, we'll be screwed.
units.displayText: I bet on when the new ammo would arrive. We used up almost all our stock on the previous round of bombardment. If it doesn't arrive soon, we'll be screwed.

spans.text: I bet on when the new ammo would arrive. We used up almost all our stock on the previous round of bombardment. If it doesn't arrive soon, we'll be screwed.

units.displayText: As the alarm screams through the air, the fire-suppression system automatically activates. The room is immediately drenched in water like a sudden storm.

units.displayText: The moment he sees his colleague go down in a puddle of blood, he flicks the safety on his gun off and prepares to spray the next person coming through the door with lead.

units.displayText: Near the enemy armory.

units.rawText: Although I managed to destroy them, I didn't think there would be so many soldiers hiding nearby...
units.displayText: Although I managed to destroy them, I didn't think there would be so many soldiers hiding nearby...

spans.text: Although I managed to destroy them, I didn't think there would be so many soldiers hiding nearby...

units.rawText: This is going to suck...
units.displayText: This is going to suck...

spans.text: This is going to suck...

units.rawText: Captain, we've got them surrounded! Your orders, please!
units.displayText: Captain, we've got them surrounded! Your orders, please!

spans.text: Captain, we've got them surrounded! Your orders, please!

units.rawText: Alright, fall back behind me and maintain a perimeter. I'm going to have a chat with this loathsome rat.
units.displayText: Alright, fall back behind me and maintain a perimeter. I'm going to have a chat with this loathsome rat.

spans.text: Alright, fall back behind me and maintain a perimeter. I'm going to have a chat with this loathsome rat.

units.rawText: ...Whose voice is that?
units.displayText: ...Whose voice is that?

spans.text: ...Whose voice is that?

units.rawText: I don't know this person, but its owner seems familiar, and it makes me shudder unconsciously.
units.displayText: I don't know this person, but its owner seems familiar, and it makes me shudder unconsciously.

spans.text: I don't know this person, but its owner seems familiar, and it makes me shudder unconsciously.

units.rawText: It's been a while, Commander. I didn't think you were still alive.
units.displayText: It's been a while, Commander. I didn't think you were still alive.

spans.text: It's been a while, Commander. I didn't think you were still alive.

units.rawText: I clearly remember putting a bullet in you and watching you die... Meh, it doesn't matter. I'll just kill you again, then.
units.displayText: I clearly remember putting a bullet in you and watching you die... Meh, it doesn't matter. I'll just kill you again, then.

spans.text: I clearly remember putting a bullet in you and watching you die... Meh, it doesn't matter. I'll just kill you again, then.

units.rawText: The sound of a safety pin being pulled from a grenade comes from him.
units.displayText: The sound of a safety pin being pulled from a grenade comes from him.

spans.text: The sound of a safety pin being pulled from a grenade comes from him.

units.rawText: Dammit!
units.displayText: Dammit!

spans.text: Dammit!

units.rawText: I instinctively leap for the cover behind me. Although my body armor stops the fragments, the shockwave sends me sprawling on the ground.
units.displayText: I instinctively leap for the cover behind me. Although my body armor stops the fragments, the shockwave sends me sprawling on the ground.

units.rawText: Ugh!
units.displayText: Ugh!

spans.text: Ugh!

units.rawText: The voice's owner appears before me. One hand steps heavily on my gun hand, and there is a smug smile on his face.
units.displayText: The voice's owner appears before me. One hand steps heavily on my gun hand, and there is a smug smile on his face.

spans.text: The voice's owner appears before me. One hand steps heavily on my gun hand, and there is a smug smile on his face.

units.rawText: So, what other tricks do you have up your sleeve, Commander?
